# Carcassonne Tour

> An independent visitor's guide to the Cité de Carcassonne — the great medieval walled city in southern France — and its self-guided, offline audio tour by TouringBee. Covers the history, the double ramparts and 52 towers, the Château Comtal, the Dame Carcas legend, tickets, and how to visit. Available in 8 languages.

## Main pages
- [Home — Carcassonne Tour](https://carcassonnetour.com/): Pillar guide to visiting the Cité de Carcassonne, with the self-guided audio tour.
- [All guides](https://carcassonnetour.com/guides/): Index of Carcassonne articles — what to see, tickets, history, the Cathars, and day trips to Toulouse and Albi.

## The audio guide
- [Carcassonne self-guided audio tour (TouringBee)](https://touringbee.com/product/carcassonne-city-tour/): Offline audio tour with a GPS map, in 8 languages, for iOS and Android, from €9.99.
